english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone is not anxious or worried about something.
Use this when careless means not worried or unconcerned about something.

examples.english: I am unconcerned about tomorrow’s interview.
examples.traditional: 我對聽日個面試唔擔心。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ting1 jat6 go3 min6 si5 m4 daam1 sam1

examples.english: They are careless about their own safety and are not worried at all.
examples.traditional: 佢對自己嘅安全完全唔擔心。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 on1 cyun4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 daam1 sam1
